answers.core: Because this can be really useful to create fast low poly meshes in editor, can be used in Particles node and to a lot of other creative things.
answers.workaround: Can be created using the SurfaceTool and Mathematic knowledge to create the primitives with this option, but this makes harder to a new user create a simple low poly project with no effort. The other solution is to create manually these meshes in Blender and them export to Godot, but again, slows down the workflow.

title: Add a option to create flat-shaded PrimitiveMeshes in Editor
